I'll take the second one — where it removes the link right away but then gives me an "Undo" for a moment that puts it back exactly where it was and fixes the count. That fits how I work: I don't want to be nagged with a confirmation box every single time I tidy up, but I do want a safety net for the times I click it by mistake. The confirm-first version would get tiring fast.

So let's go with remove-then-Undo. As for how long the Undo sticks around — give me a few seconds at least, long enough that I actually notice it and can react before it disappears.
